<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that forms an amide by coupling an aniline with an acyl‑chloride (breaks a C‑Cl halide, forms a C‑N amide).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
